snippet.title: Winnie-the-Pooh: Black Honey - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Winnie-the-Pooh: Black Honey on Steam!  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3687480/WinniethePooh_Black_Honey/

Winnie-the-Pooh: Black Honey drops you into a haunting, physics-driven open-world survival horror set in a twisted version of the Hundred Acre Wood. Every item is a potential weapon. Balloons lift pianos, bananas become traps, and pulley snares wait to catch the unwary. Survive against monstrous versions of Winnie-the-Pooh, Piglet, Eeyore, and Owl, each haunting their own territory with distinct, chilling behavior.

As you explore, gather Black Honey to gain upgrades like double jump, fast travel, enhanced strength, or advanced crafting ability. You can also collect normal honey to attempt healing your friends rather than destroying them. Your choices truly shape the fate of the forest and the tone of your survival.
